title: Dean Myron Davies
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Darla James, Salt Lake Temple, 1973; five children
Bachelor's in Agricultural Economics, BYU, 1976; Advanced Executive Leadership programs at Stanford and Northwestern
President of Equitec Properties Company, Oakland, 1977-1983; VP of Bechtel Investments Inc., San Francisco, 1983-1993; VP of High Industries, Inc., Lancaster, Pa., 1993-1995.
Counselor in three Bishoprics; Five High Councils; Counselor in two Stake Presidencies; President of the Pleasanton California and Danville California Stakes
President of the Puerto Rico San Juan Mission, 1998-2001
Second Counselor in Presiding Bishopric 2012 - present
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
